responsibility: Manages the Cranelift backend’s generation of debuggability metadata for compiled code by owning DWARF construction state and the API for defining compile units, namespaces, functions, and statics; building source file, line-table, and per-function location/range information from Rust spans and Cranelift source locations; serializing the accumulated DWARF data into debug sections and relocation records; adapting those sections and relocations to object-file output; and producing and registering associated unwind metadata such as `.eh_frame` for object emission and JIT use.
